title: Rams’ replacement for ‘The Thiccer Kicker’ has fans weighing in after MNF debacle

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams’ replacement for ‘The Thiccer Kicker’ has fans weighing in after MNF debacle
sources.description: The Los Angeles Rams cut kicker Harrison Mevis after two missed field goals, replacing him with Blake Grupe to create an 89-pound drop at the position.
